findings.summary: The four stage rows drawn above the whole-step row read as a decomposition of it, but they sum to 70.64 ms on the base arm against a 43.07 ms whole-step bar, and neither the figure nor its caption states which rows compose the whole step, so a reader cannot reconcile the parts with the total.
findings.text: The four stage rows drawn above the whole-step row read as a decomposition of it, but they sum to 70.64 ms on the base arm against a 43.07 ms whole-step bar, and neither the figure nor its caption states which rows compose the whole step, so a reader cannot reconcile the parts with the total.

item_verdicts.contrast: pass: dark value labels on white (base #555555 about 7.5:1, bucketed #216d45 about 6.3:1) and both bar fills above 3:1 against white (grey about 3.1:1, green about 4.3:1).
item_verdicts.data_ink: pass: bar length carries the measurement, the legend names the two series and each bar's value is written at its end; no gridlines, no shading, no plotted decoration.
item_verdicts.decoration: pass: white background, two flat bar colours (#929292 base, #2e8b57 bucketed), no gradient, band, frame or styled theme.
item_verdicts.label_collision: pass: every label is complete and clear of the other labels and of the bars; the longest category label (residual and booking) clears the left canvas edge by 6 px of a 1399x720 render and the axis label clears the bottom edge.
item_verdicts.legibility: pass: five stage rows with paired grey and green bars on a linear warm wall [ms] axis (0-50), each bar ending in its own two-decimal value label; readable at a glance, with the one relation the reader cannot resolve (which rows compose the whole step) recorded as a finding.
item_verdicts.table_form: pass: a paired before/after magnitude comparison, where the bar length is the point of the figure; the run's launch and compiled-copy counts live in the evidence table instead.
